model: pipeline/train_mtnn.py PitchMTNN — 6 masked residual family towers (cat([x*m, m]) input) -> attention+gate fusion (+ctx embedding, single-context vocab) -> L2 24-d embedding
heads: 2x nn.Linear(24, 1) on the shared L2 embedding (next_window_minutes MSE-z, next_window_goal_contribution MSE-z, masked where undefined)
auxiliary_loss: adjacent-window same-player InfoNCE (temp 0.07) x 0.5 over 810 train-universe pairs (the domain's retrieval-primary task)
preprocessing: vector_core MaskedZScaler fit on harness-train rows only (in build_dataset.py); targets z-scored on MTNN gradient-train rows only; predictions de-standardized to raw units
split: gradient rows: label-end < 2019-12-01; val: label-end in [2019-12-01, 2020-07-01) (early stop only); no 2020/21 row is ever forward-passed at fit time
hyperparameter_selection: chosen by VAL loss only over a 12-config grid (lr {1e-3, 3e-3} x ret_weight {0, 0.25, 0.5} x family_drop {0, 0.15}); winner lr=0.003 ret_weight=0.5 family_drop=0.0; the test split was never consulted for selection.
